finding.issue: TASK-253 r2 requires deterministic regressions to execute the actual paired-role decision implementation, not a source-string assertion or test-only semantic mirror, including the truncation fail-closed case. The new case 14 does not exercise the generated TIKTOK_PDP_EXTRACTION_SCRIPT truncation path: it supplies a FakeSession payload whose current_price_candidates and original_price_candidates are already empty. The pre-existing truncation tests likewise either assert source substrings, feed pre-empty FakeSession payloads, or simulate the traversal cap in Python. Therefore the 302-pass Runtime result does not prove that a real >300-node bounded DOM causes the actual generated collector script to discard a partial first-window U/O pair and emit empty current/original candidate sets as required by AC6.
